what: Where the process floor goes: each command spawned with posix_spawn, stdout and stderr to /dev/null, 30 warm-up runs then 300 timed; minimum and median in milliseconds. Same machine and day as tree-sitter-node-lib.json (macOS, Apple Silicon). The harness is a 20-line C loop; the empty programs are `int main(){return 0;}`, `fn main(){}` (Rust with std), a `#![no_main]` Rust program, and an Almide `effect fn main` that prints nothing.

rows.program: tree-sitter harness, --check on an empty file
Almide, main holding a 60,000-element list literal
gramide check on an empty .js file
gramide check on an empty .ts / .tsx / .go / .py / .rs file

reading.note: A list literal costs nothing at start-up, so the committed table is not the cost. The floor is paid once per process; a batched check, an outline over a directory and an editor session pay it once for hundreds of files, so it is left as it is.
